status: Native implementation contract; not completion/test evidence.
scope: All 26 flows and all 215 canonical states; canonical screen IDs only. Cross-flow targets are explicit role/context handoffs.
simulationBoundary: Penpot uses native preset input/selection/filtered/error states and overlays; arbitrary text entry, real uploads, authentication, providers, hardware and authoritative writes remain external. Same-screen targets require visible changed sample/selection/validation state, never silent no-ops.
controlRequirements: Every enabled field/select/check/tab/filter/row/action has a mapped interaction with visible response.
Every state has a meaningful primary/back/alternate route; Back and Cancel preserve invoking context.
Critical actions have confirmation and cancelled/invalid/blocked/stale/unknown alternatives as applicable.
Unknown results preserve original durable operations and never become success automatically.
Each role flow is reachable from its own entry; cross-role handoffs are labelled and have safe return context.
Record actual native IDs and live-viewer branch coverage separately from this contract.
importantCorrections: O02 prepares operator requests; no public membership grant.

S06 accepted custody goes D06; stale S07 is separate branch.
T08 print does not revoke/rotate; return T02.
L04 unknown booking reconciles; never silently jump delivered L05.

N04 reconciliation alone cannot imply N05 confirmed delivery.
